dedupe_keys.name: fliq foundation and ground performance in liquefaction experiments

description: FLIQ-Foundation and Ground Performance in Liquefaction Experiments is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Santiago Pujol, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). The consequences of seismically induced liquefaction have been intensely studied through case histories, numerical simulations, and many experiments involving shallow foundations on liquefiable soil (e.g.,Whitman and Lambe 1988, Liu and Dobry 1997, Bouckovalas et al. 1991, Hausler 2002). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3m61bq73. Keywords: liquefaction, earthquake engineering, geotechnical engineering, foundation performance, databases. Published 2014-08-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
